1.title: Why Supreme Court Justices Are Asking for More Security
1.summary: Supreme Court justices are asking lawmakers on Capitol Hill to increase their 2027 budget, with most of the additional funding earmarked for security. Ann E. Marimow, a New York Times reporter, explains why the justices say these measures are necessary to protect them from rising threats.

2.title: In Rare Testimony, Supreme Court Justices Will Ask Congress for Security Funds
2.summary: Elena Kagan and Amy Coney Barrett, the first justices to appear before lawmakers since 2019, are requesting millions of dollars to address security concerns amid rising threats.

3.title: Blanche Was a Driving Force in Retribution Campaign, Emails Show
3.summary: The cooperation of Todd Blanche in President Trump’s retribution against enemies will be a flashpoint in his confirmation hearing to be attorney general on Wednesday.

4.title: Yemen's Houthis launch missiles at Saudi Arabia after strikes on Sanaa airport
4.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis blame Saudi Arabia for the attack in Yemen's capital and say they targeted Abha airport in response.

5.title: 'If we die, we die together': Wife of man nearly sucked out of Ryanair plane speaks of ordeal
5.summary: Svetlana Grković told Serbian media that her husband is "seriously injured and in shock".

6.title: EU bans gold imports from Sudan to curb money financing the war
6.summary: The ban also restricts exports of mercury and cyanide to Sudan, chemicals widely used in gold mining.
